topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well, now, who would’ve thought it? Old Maestro, always so quiet, tending his garden like the rest of us. Turns out, he’s got a cellar full of gold, they say. Folks are whispering, wondering how long he’s been hiding his good fortune. None of us ever guessed, always seeing him mending his own shoes and patching his coat. He’s been letting his soil lay fallow this year, but now it makes sense. All this time, he could’ve bought the finest seeds and beasts, but chose not to. Makes you think, don’t it? Maybe there’s more to a man than what his field shows at harvest.
